_comment: outdoor-bosses (Docs/OutdoorBosses.md): Eric's Boss markers in MapLayout.json are WORLD BOSSES, always there, one different race boss per marker, the same boss in both realms. Which boss: the marker's own "kind" (layout editor inspector: OUTDOOR BOSS < >), else byMarker (marker name -> boss id), else roster in marker order. Boss ids are the race bosses of Races.json (warlord / colossus of each race). respawnSeconds: 0 = a slain boss stays dead (Eric), else it returns after this long. suddenDeathMinutes: at this match time SUDDEN DEATH begins: every dead world boss returns to its marker (0 = never); suddenDeathHostile: those bosses (and the living ones) are hostile, attacking champions within hostileAggroRadius cm of them, still leashed to their lair. waveBossesAtMarkers: false = wave bosses spawn at their wave's monster spawn (the markers are the world bosses' lairs). baseHealth: every boss's health (Eric: 10,000), times bossHealth[boss id] and the marker's HP x (layout editor inspector). strengthWave: damage and skills like a wave boss of at least this global wave, times damageMultiplier. lootTier: the challenge tier the boss shows and its pack-completion loot rolls at (it also rolls the lane-boss table). goldMultiplier: on the boss bounty (10x the current mob value). The leash is MonsterLeash.json's boss radius around the marker. cire.OutdoorBosses reload re-reads this file.
